This page lists the spec and status fields of EventSource and Sensor, each with its type, its limits and its description. The [Platform page](../../../platform/services/events.md) explains the concept, and the `metadata` of every kind is [the same](../../common-definitions.md#objectmeta).

## EventSource

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/events/eventsource.yaml#eventsource]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `EventSource` |

### `EventSource.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blob` | object, [`EventSource.spec.blob`](#eventsourcespecblob) | Events that fire on new and rewritten objects of a Bucket in this namespace, which funcd lists every eventing.blobPollInterval. A firing's data has the fields bucket, key, size, version and time, the object's modification time. Exactly one of timer, blob and sql. |
| `sql` | object, [`EventSource.spec.sql`](#eventsourcespecsql) | Events that fire on row changes in a SQLDatabase of this namespace. A firing's data has the fields op, table, rowId and index, and before, after and commitTimestamp when the change carries them; when before and after together pass 256 KiB, both are dropped and truncated is true. Exactly one of timer, blob and sql. |
| `timer` | object, [`EventSource.spec.timer`](#eventsourcespectimer) | Events that fire on a schedule, each on its own interval or cron expression; a firing's data is an empty object. Exactly one of timer, blob and sql. |

### `EventSource.spec.blob`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bucket` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The Bucket, in this namespace, whose objects fire the events. Until it exists, the source is not Ready, with reason BucketNotFound, and watches nothing. |
| `events` | array of [`EventSource.spec.blob.events[]`](#eventsourcespecblobevents), required | The source's events: at least one, with unique names, each watching the objects under its prefix. |

### `EventSource.spec.blob.events[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The event's name, unique among the source's events: the type of each CloudEvent it fires, and the event a Sensor dependency names. |
| `on` | array of string values | The object changes that fire the event. Created, the only one, fires for each new object and again when an object is rewritten with another size or modification time; empty means Created. |
| `prefix` | string | The key prefix the event watches: only objects whose key starts with it fire, and empty means the whole Bucket. When the source is created or this prefix changes, the objects already under it fire too, to the Sensors subscribed then: an object that no Sensor got counts as seen. |

### `EventSource.spec.sql`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The SQLDatabase, in this namespace, whose row changes fire the events. Until it exists, the source is not Ready, with reason DatabaseNotFound. |
| `events` | array of [`EventSource.spec.sql.events[]`](#eventsourcespecsqlevents), required | The source's events: at least one, with unique names, each watching one table. |

### `EventSource.spec.sql.events[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The event's name, unique among the source's events: the type of each CloudEvent it fires, and the event a Sensor dependency names. |
| `on` | array of string values | The row changes that fire the event: Insert, Update or Delete. Empty means all three. |
| `table` | string, required | The table whose row changes fire the event, matched by its exact name, case included. |

### `EventSource.spec.timer`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | array of [`EventSource.spec.timer.events[]`](#eventsourcespectimerevents), required | The timer's events: at least one, with unique names, each firing on its own schedule. |

### `EventSource.spec.timer.events[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cron` | string | A cron expression: 5 fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) or a macro such as @daily. Exactly one of interval and cron. |
| `interval` | string, a duration: whole numbers with the units h, m, s and ms, largest unit first (10m, 1h30m, 500ms) | The tick period: 100ms to 24h. Exactly one of interval and cron. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The event's name, unique among the source's events: the type of each CloudEvent it fires, and the event a Sensor dependency names. |
| `timeZone` | string | The IANA time zone of cron, such as Europe/Paris; UTC when empty. Only with cron. |

### `EventSource.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |

## Sensor

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/events/sensor.yaml#sensor]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Sensor` |

### `Sensor.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `do` | array of [`Sensor.spec.do[]`](#sensorspecdo), required | The actions the Sensor runs: at least one, with unique names. An event runs every action whose on names its dependency; a failed action is tried eventing.deliveryAttempts times in all, then stored as a dead letter, which funcdctl eventing dlq list shows; while eventing.maxQueuedPerSensor deliveries wait, a new one becomes a dead letter with no attempt. |
| `on` | array of [`Sensor.spec.on[]`](#sensorspecon), required | The events the Sensor subscribes to, as named dependencies: at least one, with unique names. |

### `Sensor.spec.do[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `function` | string, a DNS-1123 label | Each event calls this Function, in the Sensor's namespace, with the CloudEvent, whose data is the action's input; funcd starts a worker first when none runs. A Function whose protocol is http is never called: the Sensor is not Ready, with reason TargetServesHTTP, and each event for this action ends as a dead letter. Exactly one of workflow and function. |
| `input` | any JSON value | What the action passes: the run's input, or the data of the CloudEvent the Function receives. Absent or null, it is the event's data; otherwise it is a JSON object whose top-level values are literals, or strings that are a single $&#123;&#123; &#125;&#125; expression reading event.id, event.source, event.type, event.time or event.data. An input that is not an object, or holds an invalid expression, makes the Sensor not Ready, with reason InvalidInput, and then none of its actions runs. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The action's name, unique among the Sensor's actions. Dead letters record it, and a WorkflowRun it starts is named after the Sensor and this name, with a random suffix. |
| `on` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The name of the dependency whose events run this action, one of the Sensor's on entries. |
| `workflow` | string, a DNS-1123 label | Each event starts a WorkflowRun of this Workflow, in the Sensor's namespace and resource group, with the action's input. The action succeeds once the run is created; a run whose input breaks the Workflow's contract or passes workflow.payloadLimit fails at its start. Exactly one of workflow and function. |

### `Sensor.spec.on[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The name of one of that EventSource's events, which is the type of each CloudEvent the dependency receives. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The dependency's name, unique among the Sensor's dependencies; an action's on names it. |
| `source` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The name of an EventSource in the Sensor's namespace. |

### `Sensor.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |

| 200 |  | OK |  |

| `DELETE` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/namespaces/{namespace}/sensors/{name}` | `deleteSensor` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

| Parameter | In | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | path | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's namespace. |
| `name` | path | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's name. |
| `If-Match` | header | string | One strong entity-tag, the quoted resourceVersion, or \*: the write is conditional on it. |

Answer: none.

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 204 |  | No Content |  |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | The If-Match header is not one strong entity-tag, such as "42", or \*. | Send one If-Match line with the quoted resourceVersion, or \*. |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role or namespaces do not allow it to delete a Sensor in the namespace. | Use a credential whose role allows it, such as a developer of the namespace or an admin. |
| 404 | `urn:funcd:problem:not-found` | No Sensor of that name exists in the namespace. | Check the name and the namespace. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | The Sensor has changed since the resourceVersion that If-Match or metadata.resourceVersion names. | Read the Sensor again, apply the change to it, and send it with its new resourceVersion. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The namespace or the name in the path is not a DNS-1123 label. | Use at most 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a digit. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The query holds a parameter that the operation does not take. | Send only the parameters that the operation lists. |

### List the dead letters of a namespace

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/namespaces/{namespace}/deadletters` | `listDeadLetters` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

| Parameter | In | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | path | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The namespace of the dead letters. |

Answer: [`DeadLetterListOutputBody`](#deadletterlistoutputbody).

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 |  | OK |  |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role or namespaces do not allow it to read Sensors in the namespace. | Use a credential whose role allows it, such as a developer of the namespace or an admin. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The namespace in the path is not a DNS-1123 label. | Use at most 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a digit. |

#### `DeadLetterListOutputBody`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [`DeadLetterListOutputBody.items[]`](#deadletterlistoutputbodyitems), required | The namespace's dead letters, newest first. |

#### `DeadLetterListOutputBody.items[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string, required | The name of the Sensor's action that failed. |
| `attempts` | integer, required | The delivery attempts made before funcd parked the action: 0 when it parked the action before any attempt, such as when the Sensor's queue was full, and after a replay that failed. |
| `event` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The name of the event, as the Sensor's dependency names it. |
| `failedAt` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When funcd parked the action, or when its last replay failed. |
| `id` | string, required | The dead letter's ID, a ULID that funcd mints when it parks the action. |
| `namespace` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The namespace of the Sensor. |
| `payload` | any JSON value, required | The CloudEvent that the action was to deliver, as JSON. A replay delivers it again. |
| `reason` | string, required | Why the last attempt failed, or why funcd parked the action before its attempts ran out. |
| `sensor` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The Sensor whose action failed. |
| `source` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The EventSource of the event, as the Sensor's dependency names it. |

### Replay a dead letter

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/namespaces/{namespace}/deadletters/{id}/replay` | `replayDeadLetter` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

| Parameter | In | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | path | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The dead letter's namespace. |
| `id` | path | string, required | The dead letter's ID. |

Answer: none.

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 204 |  | No Content |  |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | The action's input in the Sensor is not a JSON object, or holds an expression that does not evaluate; the dead letter stays. | Correct the action's input in the Sensor, then retry. |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role or namespaces do not allow it to delete Sensors in the namespace. | Use a credential whose role allows it, such as a developer of the namespace or an admin. |
| 404 | `urn:funcd:problem:not-found` | No dead letter of that ID exists in the namespace. | Check the ID: funcdctl eventing dlq list lists the namespace's dead letters. |
| 404 | `urn:funcd:problem:not-found` | The Sensor that the dead letter names no longer exists. | Apply the Sensor again, then retry, or discard the dead letter. |
| 404 | `urn:funcd:problem:not-found` | The Sensor no longer has the dead letter's action. | Add the action back to the Sensor, then retry, or discard the dead letter. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | Another replay of the dead letter is running. | Retry once that replay has ended. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | The action's Function serves HTTP, so only the edge calls it; the dead letter stays. | Point the action at a Function that does not serve HTTP, then retry. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The namespace in the path is not a DNS-1123 label. | Use at most 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a digit. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The query holds a parameter that the operation does not take. | Send only the parameters that the operation lists. |
| 503 | `urn:funcd:problem:unavailable` | The platform or the namespace is held, so funcd delivers no event. | Retry once the hold is released, which funcdctl hold release does. |
| 503 | `urn:funcd:problem:unavailable` | The delivery failed again, such as on a Function that is missing, has no ready worker or answers an error; the dead letter stays, with its attempts reset and the new reason. | Correct what the dead letter's reason names, then retry. |
